details: com.unity.external-dependency-manager is a dependency-confusion package that takes the name of Unity's External Dependency Manager, a package Unity distributes from its own registry rather than npm; it has no functional code and its description is "A utility for managing SVG buckets." Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/6fc1b78a-5046-4192-abc9-edf993a31b33`, revealing to the collector that the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account depipp777, which has no other packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
